response.body:
Configuring retry policies

Retry policies control how the client library responds to transient failures such as connection resets or 503 responses from the upstream service.

Basic configuration

Set maxRetries and backoffMs on the client options object to enable exponential backoff between attempts.

Disabling retries

Pass maxRetries: 0 to disable retry behavior entirely, which is useful when the caller implements its own retry loop.
